answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one gale weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 137 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 11 times the capital for one share. The nebula report shows the merge explicitly at each walnut. A farm of 2812 identities would post 4732 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
